one_liner_ko: 칸아카데미가 만든 AI 개인 튜터 겸 교사용 수업 보조 도구.
what_it_does_ko: Khanmigo는 비영리 교육기관 칸아카데미의 AI 개인 튜터이자 교사 보조 도구다. 학습자에게 답을 바로 주지 않고 스스로 답을 찾도록 이끌며, 칸아카데미 콘텐츠 라이브러리(수학·인문·코딩·사회 등)와 연결돼 있다. 교사는 수업 계획, 퀴즈 문제, 루브릭, 출구 티켓 등을 빠르게 만들 수 있다. 초등학생부터 대학생까지 대부분의 학과목을 돕는다.
key_features: 답을 주지 않고 유도하는 AI 튜터링
부모 계정에서 자녀 대화 기록 확인·조정 알림
use_cases_ko: 교사가 수업 준비 업무를 빠르게 처리
학습자가 수학·SQL·에세이 쓰기 등 기술 학습

evidence.quote: Meet Khanmigo: Khan Academy's AI-powered teaching assistant & tutor
Khanmigo is an AI-powered personal tutor and teaching assistant from trusted education nonprofit Khan Academy.
Khanmigo doesn’t just give answers. Instead, with limitless patience, it guides learners to find the answer themselves.
differentiation, lesson plans, quiz questions, student groupings, hooks, exit tickets, rubrics, and more
Khanmigo can help students who are in elementary school through college.
Generate standards-aligned, differentiated lesson planning tied to our content library.
Create learning objectives, rubrics, and even exit tickets.
Get an on-demand summary of student work to assess progress and identify areas for support.
AI-enhanced writing practice and instruction tool
View the history of your children’s interactions and get moderation alerts.
Co-teaching support, automatic rostering, and single sign-on (SSO) through Clever SecureSync or ClassLink
Knock something off your to-do list in minutes
Type in a homework question and get instant help.
Learn new skills anytime, whether it's algebra, SQL, or essay writing.
Khanmigo pricing: Free for teachers, $4/month for parents & learners
you will have the option to enable access for up to 10 of your children who are under 18
